I am a young man here in Ntcheu, and this small rice plot is important for my family's food. I have some schooling so I know fertilizer helps the rice grow strong, but money is tight, so I will buy only a small bag of Urea and maybe some D-compound if I can manage. I keep a few chickens and goats, so I will carry their manure to the field before planting. I cannot afford pesticides or to hire many people — my brothers and I will do most of the work ourselves, and this rice field sits in a dambo area so it gets water naturally during the rains.
